title: 第七章 镜湖道院的决选第八章 秘技三秋叶
lines: 孟川忍不住再度尝试，一瞬间身心技三者合一，人随着刀光在破空前行，只见练武场中留下一个又一个残影，一道又一道惊艳的刀光。
快！飘忽！
这是秘技‘三秋叶’的特色。
身法快且飘忽！刀法也快且飘忽！
连续施展十余次，孟川才停下，难以压抑自身的激动：“三秋叶，一叶落尽三秋！我终于悟出了！我终于悟出了！
“我终于达到了刀法的第一个大境界——合一境！”
“我孟川，有望成为神魔！”
孟川真的很激动。
十一岁那年修炼落叶刀。
四年了。
这四年他从未懈怠，拼命修炼着，是因为他很清楚，在刀法基础阶段表现优秀的有很多，哪个道院都有一些。八大道院加起来就更多了，这种优秀的修行者……九成九都会卡在‘合一境’的门槛前很久，逐渐变得平庸，此生能成无漏境就不错了。
可这从来不是孟川的目标，他要成神魔！他如此刻苦，如此钻研，只有一个目标——神魔！
他忘不了，六岁时被绑在父亲的背上，父亲边逃边抵抗妖族，在危急时刻，母亲更是主动杀过去，拖延住了妖怪。
都是为了他这个儿子能逃掉！
在父亲背上，遥遥看到母亲被更多妖怪淹没，当时的孟川哭的撕心裂肺，父亲流着泪却不回头拼命逃着。终于……孟川活下来了。
“修行必须越早越好，凡人肉身，二十岁达到巅峰，随后以缓慢速度下滑。”
孟川暗道，“如今东宁府第一天才‘梅元知’，就是十五岁悟出秘技，就在一个月前，他二十岁悟出‘冰势’。甚至都能居住在玉阳宫内，在玉阳宫内修行。”
梅元知，本是东宁府普通家庭出身，他母亲是婢女，父亲也只是一位脱胎境罢了。
可梅元知十五岁悟出秘技，震惊道院，道院立即大力栽培，神魔家族们也想要将家族嫡女许给他，可梅元知一心修行，根本不被神魔家族所诱惑……终于，今年正月十二那天，梅元知悟出了‘冰势’。险险的在二十岁的年纪悟出了‘势’，他今年自然有机会去搏一搏，有些许希望进入最古老的修行之地‘元初山’。
按照元初山的规矩，参加入门考验，不得超过二十岁。
“我达到合一境，这才是跨出第一步。还有‘刀势’‘凝丹’诸多门槛，不能松懈。”孟川默默道，环顾四周，练武场内很安静只有自己一人，那些树木花草都已经一片绿色。
“真巧。”孟川反应过来，“今天二月二十七，我竟然在道院内部决选名额的前一天突破。”
世间事，有时候就是这么巧。
第二天，清晨。
孟川、柳七月在吃早饭。
如今整个孟家都在倾力栽培着后辈子弟，都请外面的无漏境来给孟川陪练了。悟出刀势的无漏境强者‘孟大江’自然要发挥用处，他最近都常住祖宅，教导族内大批小辈们。至于孟川……他得到父亲指点的机会太多了，父亲的那一套他早就熟悉了。
而七月的父亲‘柳夜白’却神秘的很，一年大多时间都在外。
“阿川，今天我们道院决选名额，你们也是今天吧。”柳七月得意道，“我可已经拿到名额了。”
“我今天也会拿到。”孟川微笑道。
“这么有把握？”柳七月笑道，“洗髓境都还没圆满，就有把握夺得道院内前三？”
“如果我赢了怎么办？”孟川问道。
柳七月仔细看着孟川，随即嘿嘿笑道：“如果你赢了，我给你做一个月的晚饭。可如果你没能夺得名额，嘿嘿嘿，你得将你的骏马图给我！敢不敢赌？”
孟川笑了。
他的画技早超越在东宁府找到的最好的画师了，当然也有画师比较少的缘故。
骏马图，是孟川如今最高成就，画的一幅长卷画，画了足足一百匹不同神态的马，前后耗费了一年多时间，柳七月自从看过一次就一直眼馋。连云青萍看过一次，都说愿意出三千两加她的两块宝玉来换。孟川都舍不得换。
“我输了就要赔上骏马图，赢了你才做一个月晚饭，是不是不太公平？”孟川犹豫道。
“一个月呢！你到底敢不敢？”柳七月盯着孟川。
“平常让你做一次饭都难，行，就赌这一次。”孟川咬牙道，“到时候输了，可别后悔。”
content_en:
Meng Chuan couldn't help but try again. In an instant, his body, mind, and skills merged into one. He followed the light of the sword and moved forward through the air. He saw only afterimages and afterimages left in the training ground, one after another of stunning sword lights.
quick! uncertain!
This is the characteristic of the secret technique ‘Three Autumn Leaves’.
The movement is fast and erratic! The sword skills are also fast and erratic!
After performing it for more than ten times in a row, Meng Chuan stopped, unable to suppress his excitement: "Three autumn leaves, one leaf fell and three autumns were lost! I finally figured it out! I finally figured it out!
"I finally reached the first great realm of swordsmanship - the unity realm! "
“I, Meng Chuan, am expected to become a god and demon! "
Meng Chuan was really excited.
When he was eleven years old, he practiced falling leaf knife.
Four years.
He has never slacked off in the past four years and practiced hard because he knows very well that there are many excellent people in the basic stage of swordsmanship, and there are some in every Taoist school. The total number of the Eight Great Paths is even greater. Ninety-nine percent of such excellent practitioners... will be stuck at the threshold of the 'Unity Realm' for a long time and gradually become mediocre. It would be great if they can reach the No-Leakage Realm in this life.
But this has never been Meng Chuan's goal, he wants to become a god and demon! He worked so hard and studied so hard, with only one goal - gods and demons!
He could not forget that when he was six years old, he was tied to his father's back. His father fled while resisting the monsters. In a critical moment, his mother even took the initiative to kill him and delay the monsters.
All because his son could escape!
On his father's back, he saw his mother being drowned by more monsters from a distance. Meng Chuan cried heartbreakingly at that time, while his father was crying but did not look back and ran away desperately. Finally... Meng Chuan survived.
"Cultivation must be done as early as possible. The mortal body reaches its peak at the age of twenty, and then declines at a slow rate. "
Meng Chuan secretly thought, "Now the number one genius in Dongning Mansion, Mei Yuanzhi, discovered the secret technique at the age of fifteen. Just a month ago, he discovered the 'Ice Force' at the age of twenty. You can even live in Yuyang Palace and practice in Yuyang Palace. "
Mei Yuanzhi was originally from an ordinary family in Dongning Prefecture. His mother was a maid and his father was just a reborn person.
But Mei Yuanzhi realized the secret skill at the age of fifteen, which shocked the Taoist temple. The Taoist temple immediately vigorously cultivated him, and the gods and demons family also wanted to marry their legitimate daughter to him, but Mei Yuanzhi devoted himself to cultivation and was not tempted by the gods and demons family at all... Finally, on the twelfth day of the first month of this year, Mei Yuanzhi realized the 'ice power'. Having realized the 'potential' at the age of twenty, he naturally has the opportunity to give it a try this year, with some hope of entering the oldest place of cultivation, 'Yuanchu Mountain'.
According to the rules of Yuanchu Mountain, one must not be over twenty years old to participate in the entrance test.
“When I reach the state of unity, this is the first step. There are also many thresholds for 'sword power' and 'coil condensation', so we cannot relax. "Meng Chuan said silently, looking around. He was the only one in the martial arts training ground. It was very quiet. The trees, flowers and grass were all green.
"What a coincidence. "Meng Chuan reacted, "Today, February 27th, I actually broke through the day before the final selection within the Taoist Academy. "
Things in this world are so coincidental sometimes.
…
The next day, early morning.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were having breakfast.
Now the entire Meng family is working hard to cultivate the next generation, and they have invited Wuluojing from outside to train Meng Chuan. Meng Dajiang, a strong man in the Wuliu Realm who has realized the power of the sword, will naturally be of use. He has been living in his ancestral home recently, teaching a large number of juniors in the clan. As for Meng Chuan... he has had too many opportunities to get guidance from his father, and he has long been familiar with his father's tricks.
However, Qi Qi’s father ‘Liu Yebai’ is very mysterious and spends most of the year away from home.
"Achuan, today is the final election for our Taoist academy, so it should be today for you too. "Liu Qiyue said proudly, "I have already obtained the quota. "
“I’ll get it today too. "Meng Chuan smiled.
"So confident? "Liu Qiyue said with a smile, "You haven't even completed the marrow cleansing stage yet, but you are sure to win the top three in the Taoist Academy? "
“What if I win? Meng Chuan asked.
Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan carefully, then chuckled and said: "If you win, I will cook dinner for you for a month. But if you fail to win the spot, hehehe, you have to give me your horse picture! Do you dare to bet? "
Meng Chuan smiled.
His painting skills have long surpassed the best painters found in Dongning Mansion. Of course, this is also because there are relatively few painters.
The painting of horses is Meng Chuan's highest achievement today. He painted a long scroll painting of a hundred horses with different expressions. It took more than a year to paint. Liu Qiyue had been craving it ever since he saw it once. Even Yun Qingping saw it once and said she was willing to pay three thousand taels plus two of her precious jade in exchange. Meng Chuan was reluctant to change.
"If I lose, I have to pay the horse figure. If I win, you only have to cook dinner for a month. Isn't it unfair? "Meng Chuan hesitated.
"One month! Do you dare? "Liu Qiyue stared at Meng Chuan.
"It's usually difficult for you to cook once, okay, let's make a bet this time. "Meng Chuan gritted his teeth and said, "If you lose then, don't regret it. "
title_en: Chapter 7 The Final Selection at Jinghu Taoist Temple Chapter 8 The Secret Technique of Three Autumn Leaves
